transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I haven’t been myself. I don’t really do much anymore. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, keep up with people, but now I mostly just sit in my rental for hours. I know there are things I should do, I just… can’t get myself to start.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?
I don’t know. Not sad, exactly. More like… flat, maybe. Empty sometimes, but I don’t really think about it that way.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to do, like hiking or playing guitar, when you do manage to start them?

Not really. Even if I pick up the guitar or think about hiking, it doesn’t… do much for me. Mostly I don’t even get that far. I just sit there knowing I should do something, and I can’t make myself start.
Do you find pleasure in anything at all anymore?

Not much, no. I mean… maybe little things here and there, but mostly I don’t feel like myself anymore. I stopped hiking, coaching, playing guitar… I don’t really call people back. Some days I just sit in my rental for hours, knowing there’s stuff I should do, and I just can’t get started.
Do you often feel guilty about anything?
I don’t know… not really guilty, I guess. I mean, there are things I probably should be doing, but I don’t think of it as guilt exactly.
Do you feel anxious about anything?
I’m not sure. Not anxious exactly… I mean, I get uneasy sometimes, but I don’t know what it’s about.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been checking… clothes seem about the same, I guess.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, or have trouble getting started with physical activities?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to do more, like hiking and coaching, playing guitar. Now I mostly just sit in my rental for hours, knowing I should get up and do things, but… I don’t start.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I guess… since I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce. That was about a year and two months ago. Things have kind of been unraveling since then.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I… I don’t know. Not really something I want to get into. I haven’t… I’m not sure.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself since you started feeling this way?
I… I don’t know. I don’t really want to say yes or no. It’s just been hard, and I try not to think about that kind of thing.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to?
Yeah… maybe. It’s more like I just don’t get going. I’ll sit in the rental for hours, knowing I should do things, and I just… can’t make myself start. I don’t hike or play guitar much anymore either.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now you have no interest in doing them?

Yeah. I used to hike, play guitar… I helped coach some too. I don’t really do any of that now. I don’t even call people back much. Mostly I just sit around the rental and… don’t get started on anything.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better and were able to do a few things you wanted to?

Not really. Maybe a little here and there, but… mostly I still just sit there knowing there are things I should do, and I can’t get myself started. I haven’t really gotten back to hiking or guitar or calling people much.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt completely normal and were able to do all the things you wanted to?

No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really felt normal. Mostly I just sit in that rental, and I know there’s stuff I should do, but I can’t get myself to start. I’m not hiking or playing guitar or calling people back like I used to.
Have you had any significant changes in appetite since you started feeling this way?
I don’t know… not really. I haven’t been paying that much attention to it.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?
I’m not sure. I might be lying around more, but I don’t know if I’m actually sleeping more.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to or have trouble getting started with physical activities, or do you feel restless and can't sit still?

Yeah… getting started is the thing. I don’t know if I’m moving slower exactly, but I’ll sit there for hours knowing I should do something and just… don’t. I stopped doing stuff like hiking, coaching, playing guitar. Even calling people back feels hard.
Do you feel noticeably worse in the morning?
I don’t think so. Mornings aren’t… I mean, I haven’t noticed them being worse specifically.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I… I don’t really want to get into that. I’m not sure.
